description: Mint your Vaultfire Street Cred badge — an ERC-5192 soulbound token that reflects your on-chain reputation tier (None / Bronze / Silver / Gold / Platinum). Pay $0.20 USDC, sign in your wallet on Base. One badge per address, non-transferable.
